target_customer: Indian homeowners and contractors buying floor and wall materials (tiles, laminates, wall panels)
problem: Home decor materials go through layered traditional distribution, so prices are high and design choice is slow to refresh.

founders.name: Manish Reddy
prior_employers: Boston Consulting Group (3.5 years, India and USA)

technical_complexity.rationale: Ecommerce plus supply chain and logistics; operations harder than software.

defensibility.rationale: Manufacturer relationships and small-batch design launches may help, but unverified.

market_need_then: YC page says it has served over 10,000 homes (company claim); no dated demand evidence collected.

branding.domain_note: Site materialdepot.in redirects (301) to materialdepot.com; acquisition date unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: No source on brand strength found; not rated.

outcome_analysis: Material Depot (Winter 2022, Active) has a team of 50, the largest in this shard, which suggests real operations, but no funding, revenue or independent coverage was gathered, so the story cannot be told reliably.
notes: The web search budget was exhausted before the required outcome, funding cross-check, dated-competitor and branding searches could run, so competition_at_founding is empty and brand fields rest only on the YC page and the company site.
